column3: Regional Delivery Performance, First Half of 2026
This page compares delivery performance across the five regions served by the Tamberlin depot. Figures cover all parcels dispatched between 1 January and 30 June.

The Coastal region again had the lowest share of late deliveries. Most complaints about damaged parcels came from a single faulty conveyor, which has since been replaced.
